title: seetzenia lanata
intro: Seetzenia lanata, commonly known as Milk Vetch, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family that is native to the dry regions of India and Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Seetzenia lanata include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
